programs.name: Low point forward
programs.from: Golf coach chat, Sep 30 2026: stop casting by getting pressure and the low point forward. Gates reset Oct 1 to the owner's numbers: strike -20 to -8 (Square's reading), attack -3 to -6
programs.bringBack: Attack angle, dynamic loft and face to path for each block, the shot order, and one down-the-line frame at impact from a toe-tap swing.

blocks.name: Lead foot only
blocks.how: Pull the trail foot back so only its toe touches the mat. 3/4 swings, no ball, brush the mat.
blocks.ask: Brush at or ahead of the ball spot?
blocks.extraBall: Hit one toe-tap swing with a ball for the down-the-line impact frame your coach asked for.

blocks.name: Step through
blocks.how: Feet together, swing back, step the lead foot toward the target as the downswing starts. The hands follow the step. No ball.
blocks.ask: Belt buckle open and all your weight on the lead foot?

blocks.name: Flush line
blocks.how: Foot spray or a dry-erase line from the ball toward the target (no tape). 7 iron at 3/4 speed; read where the mark starts.
blocks.ask: Mark starts at or ahead of the ball?

blocks.name: Transfer
blocks.how: Full-speed 7 iron, one ball, full routine, no do-overs. Drop the step, keep the feel.

programs.name: Low point retention check
programs.from: Golf coach chat, Oct 1 2026: does the steeper strike hold with no drill? After a day off, first 7 irons of the session; again after a second day off before retiring the drill
programs.clubs: 7 iron only, cold: right after the test ball, no drills or warm-up swings first
programs.bringBack: Median attack angle, dynamic loft and strike, and how many shots landed in the strike band.

blocks.name: Cold 7 irons
blocks.how: 10 full 7 irons, full routine, no drill and no rehearsal swings. Just hit.

programs.name: Sequence: Tier 1 (no ball)
programs.from: Golf coach chat, Oct 2 2026: the 3D showed the arms peaking ~50 ms before impact and the pelvis ~33 ms after it, hips square at impact, on all 40 swings. Tier 1 of 3 (Tier 2: blocked 3/4 7 irons, Tier 3: full speed, both gated on the 3D, not built yet). The coach's own Tier 1 gate is 10 in a row with the pelvis peak 20 ms or more before the arm peak; with no ball nothing is filmed, so the golfer judges by feel here.
programs.bringBack: Whether the lead hip started the downswing on its own on the pause reps, or the arms went with it, and how many in a row.

blocks.name: Step and fire
blocks.how: Feet together, swing back, step the lead foot toward the target, and as it lands turn the belt buckle to the target. The hands follow. No ball.
blocks.ask: Buckle turned to the target as the foot landed, hands following?

blocks.name: Pause at the top
blocks.how: Pause one second at the top, then start the downswing with the lead hip alone: the arms wait and fall. No added effort. No ball.
blocks.ask: Did the lead hip start on its own, with the arms waiting (not together)?
